D.design: Post-discovery prereg exploratory quality audit, not independent blind confirmation

A: Do original Xunta electoral notice 2024 and executive summary reconcile arithmetically at voters-valid-nulls, province and party grain, and which claims fail?

B.H1: DOG national aggregate values and Xunta overview differ from reconciled province and candidate sums; source-level quality alert

B.Halt: Differences arise from unlabelled denominator or different revision and need provenance classification

C: Use DOG 2024 original HTML sections I and II to extract all provincial voting totals and nationally listed party votes; independently calculate identities voters=valid+null; valid=candidaturas+blank; sum four provinces; sum 11 party counts; compare executive summary. Negative control must preserve correct fields, no patching official original.
F: Check different years/office contexts, total vote subtraction, 2024 summary reused 2020 figures, never silently correct raw document
G: Both from Xunta institutional family, arithmetic is independent of source fields but not external independent publisher
H: CT2=29, no uplift for detected clerical defect
J: Retain exact discrepancies, severity, and proposed source precedence instead of guessed repaired official source
